purpose: Reviewed restaurant telephone answers for a fictional table-reservation demo. No real menu, allergen safety, availability or staff notification claims.

variants_et: Mul on pähkliallergia. Kas teie toit on ohutu?
Kas mul on siin tsöliaakiaga ohutu süüa?
entries.answer_et: Mul pole kinnitatud infot menüü ega allergeenide kohta. Seetõttu ei saa ma eritoitu lubada.
variants_en: What food do you serve?
Do you have vegetarian food?
Do you have vegan food?
Do you have gluten-free food?
Do you have lactose-free food?
Is your food nut-free?
Is your kitchen nut-free?
I have a peanut allergy. Is your food safe?
Can you prevent allergen cross-contact?
Do you have a children's menu?
Do you have an allergen-free menu?
Is it safe for me to eat here with coeliac disease?
entries.answer_en: The demo has no verified menu or allergen information. I can't promise specific dietary options.
variants_ru: У меня аллергия на арахис. Мне безопасно у вас есть?
Можете исключить перекрёстный контакт с аллергенами?
Мне безопасно у вас есть при целиакии?
entries.answer_ru: В этой демонстрации нет подтверждённой информации о меню и аллергенах. Я не могу обещать конкретное специальное питание.

entries.question_et: Kas saate minu allergiast köögile teatada?
variants_et: Kas saate mu allergia broneeringule kirja panna?
entries.answer_et: Selles demos ei saa ma erisoove kirja panna ega köögile edasi anda. Toidu ohutust allergia korral ei saa ma kinnitada.
entries.question_en: Can you tell the kitchen about my allergy?
variants_en: Can you record an allergy note?
Can you add a special request to my booking?
Tell the kitchen about my peanut allergy.
Make a note of my allergy.
entries.answer_en: This demo can't save special requests or notify the kitchen. I can't confirm allergy safety.
entries.question_ru: Можете сообщить кухне о моей аллергии?
variants_ru: Можете записать мою аллергию в бронирование?
Можете добавить особое пожелание к бронированию?
Сообщите кухне о моей аллергии на арахис.
entries.answer_ru: Эта демонстрация не сохраняет особые пожелания и не уведомляет кухню. Я не могу подтвердить безопасность при аллергии.

entries.answer_et: See demo ei võta vastu toidutellimusi. Saan vastata restorani kohta käivatele küsimustele.
variants_en: Can I order food delivery?
Can I order dinner in advance?
Order dinner for me.
Can I order food?
entries.answer_en: This demo doesn't take food, takeaway or delivery orders. I can answer questions about the restaurant demo.
entries.answer_ru: Эта демонстрация не принимает заказы еды, навынос или с доставкой. Я могу ответить на вопросы о демонстрации ресторана.

entries.answer_et: Restorani lahtiolekuaegu pole selles demos veel määratud.
entries.question_en: What are the restaurant opening hours?
variants_en: When is the restaurant open?
What time does the restaurant open?
What time does the restaurant close?
Are you open today?
entries.answer_en: Restaurant opening hours haven't been configured in this demo yet.
entries.answer_ru: Часы работы ресторана в этой демонстрации пока не настроены.

variants_et: Kas saan siin päris lauda broneerida?
Kas saan laua siin päriselt broneerida?
entries.answer_et: Selles demos ei saa veel lauda broneerida. Restorani lauabroneeringute süsteem pole seadistatud.
entries.question_en: Can I book a table at the restaurant?
variants_en: Can I make a real table reservation here?
Can I book a table here?
I would like to book a table at the restaurant.
entries.answer_en: You can't book a table in this demo yet. The restaurant table reservation system hasn't been configured.
entries.answer_ru: В этой демонстрации пока нельзя забронировать столик. Система бронирования столиков ресторана не настроена.
